verdict.rationale: Composio is a tool-execution gateway, so an audit log of tool calls is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never documents a tool-call log, execution history, or replay capability. The CLI's ability to "debug Composio projects" and trigger webhooks are adjacent features and do not show a per-call audit trail.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did
